response.rationale: Both forms denote the same small, acidic green citrus fruit. “Jeruk nipis” is the ordinary Indonesian term, while “limau nipis” is the ordinary Malaysian term, making this a useful national vocabulary contrast.
response.shared_synonym_rationale: “Jeruk nipis” may be understood in Malaysia, but “limau nipis” is the ordinary Malaysian preference; likewise, “limau nipis” is not the ordinary Indonesian term. This does not undermine the contrast.
